changes: Unified the POS product search and barcode entry into one responsive input for product names, categories, and physical barcode scanners.
Added the camera icon scanner action to the unified POS search while preserving the existing scanner modal and barcode lookup flow.
Fixed Version Notice and Trusted Device Quick Login modal sequencing so only one modal is active at a time.
Fixed modal layering so standard and scanner modals cover the floating cart control without changing the cart layout or behavior.
Improved the camera scanner modal for desktop, laptop, tablet, and narrow mobile viewports with constrained sizing and scrollable content.
